key_idea: A segment blocks the ride iff its endpoints have opposite x signs and its intersection with x=0 has positive y; take the minimum such y.
sketch: Since x1,x2 are nonzero, a barricade crosses the Y axis iff sign(x1)!=sign(x2). Interpolate y = y1 + (y2-y1)*(-x1)/(x2-x1) and keep it if y>0 (it cannot be 0 as no barricade passes through the origin). Output the minimum, or -1.0 if none. O(n). Pitfall: crossings on the negative Y axis must be ignored.
